text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to do tasks that normally require human intelligence. This includes learning, problem-solving, and understanding language. Machine learning is a part of AI that allows computers to learn from data without being programmed for every situation. Deep learning is a more advanced type of machine learning that uses large neural networks to handle complex tasks like image and speech recognition. Today, AI is used in many daily activities. For example, it helps recommend films on streaming services, powers voice assistants on smartphones, and improves safety features in modern cars. AI is becoming a bigger part of our everyday lives.
